info.name: ArgueBot local conversation service
info.description: Runnable local contract coverage. Requests send {{token}} as a bearer token; it defaults to the default administrator token arguebotadmin, and Authentication > Sign in replaces it with a session token. Provider secrets are write-only configuration. State-creating requests use fictional records. Model execution, settings changes and restart require allowExecution=true; use the committed local simulation before enabling it. Generated from assets/api-contract.json and the typed C# DTOs.

item.name: Return zero-filled UTC activity buckets for a bounded range

request.description: Access: tenant administrators (and system administrators) of the caller's tenant. A system administrator may send x-tenant-id to act in another tenant; the bypass is audited.  Return zero-filled UTC activity buckets for a bounded range

exec: if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Activity has fixed intervals and nonnegative counts',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json();const minutes=Number(pm.variables.get('bucketMinutes'));const from=Date.parse(pm.variables.get('fromUtc')),to=Date.parse(pm.variables.get('toUtc'));pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array');if(rows.length){pm.expect(rows.length).to.equal(Math.ceil((to-from)/(minutes*60000)));rows.forEach((row,index)=>{pm.expect(Date.parse(row.startUtc)).to.equal(from+index*minutes*60000);pm.expect(row.success).to.be.at.least(0);pm.expect(row.failure).to.be.at.least(0);});}});
